posReady.noProducts: No matching products. Try a name, SKU or barcode.
posReady.barcodeUnknown: Unknown barcode or inactive product. Check the code.
posReady.barcodeAmbiguous: This barcode maps to multiple products. Resolve the catalog mapping before selling.
posReady.barcodeOnline: Barcode lookup requires an online catalog. You can search synchronized products offline.
posReady.quote: Quoted selling prices and FEFO lots
posReady.unavailable: No sellable quantity for this cart. Expired, quarantined, recalled, disposed and depleted lots are excluded. Reduce quantity or check stock.
posReady.changed: Prices or allocated lots changed. Review the updated quote and explicitly accept it before checkout.
posReady.quantityInvalid: Enter a positive quantity with up to four decimals (dot or comma).
posReady.cashInvalid: Cash tendered must cover the amount due, with up to two decimals.
posReady.recorded: Card, mobile money, bank transfer and other methods record payments collected externally. This app does not process them.
posReady.defaultPayment: The configured pharmacy payment method is used by default. You may change it for this sale.
posReady.recovery: This sale attempt is retained. Check or retry the same attempt to recover its result; the cart is locked until the outcome is known.
posReady.historyError: Sales could not be loaded. Retry the search.
posReady.detailError: Sale details could not be loaded. Retry.
posReady.refundInvalid: Select an item and enter a valid positive quantity no greater than its remaining refundable quantity.
posReady.refundChanged: Refundable quantity changed. Review the refreshed sale before continuing.
posReady.refundRecovery: Refund response is uncertain. Use the same retained action to check or retry; do not start another refund.
posReady.refundEffect: Returns go to the original lot. The server controls inventory reversal. Refunds are separate records; original payment records remain unchanged. Return funds externally where required.
posReady.multiBatch: Each sold item / lot is shown separately. Select the exact original lot row to return; this preserves the existing refund allocation.
posReady.printUnavailable: Printing is unavailable. Use the receipt view.
posReady.offline: Sales history and refunds require an online connection.
posReady.receiptUnavailable: Sale accepted. Receipt details could not be loaded; recover this same sale to view them.
posReady.invalidDate: Enter a valid date as YYYY-MM-DD.
posReady.pendingReceipt: Pending sync — this is a local sale intent, not a completed server receipt.
posReady.storageUnavailable: The attempt could not be saved on this device. Nothing was submitted. Retry when device storage is available.
